tipoComprobanteEmision.description: Subset of catalog 01 in issuing scope (R-01).

montoDecimal.description: Amount with 2 decimals as text, never float (R-28). E.g. "118.00".

montoUnitario.description: Unit value/price: up to 10 decimals (UBL n(12,10)).

ruc.description: RUC: 11 digits with a valid prefix. The modulo-11 check digit is validated by the domain (R-10).

serie.description: 4-character series; F = invoice and its notes, B = receipt and its notes (R-02, R-04).

codigoEstablecimiento.description: SUNAT branch establishment code; 0000 = registered address (UBL cbc:AddressTypeCode).
